blocks.text: Greatsword weapon. An Nation edition : it shows Nation instead of its grade letter and keeps its edition color, but its grade (Trash F to Mythic S) is still rolled when it drops and sets its stats.

blocks.text: Base values are for grade E, Common, +0. They grow with the grade and the forge level: see Item formulas .

blocks.text: Can be upgraded up to +10 at the forge ( +25 once the weapon is grade S, Mythic) (each level adds 8% to the main stats). Upgrades never fail.
